snippet.title: Greedy Greedy Gnomes Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Greedy Greedy Gnomes is a deceptivaly simple incremental idle RPG. Seeking a fortune, you've come to the quaint town of Eldor'idle, where citizens sit around in their houses all day. The house have pots. The pots have coins! Click on a pot and get one coin. You see where this is going!

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4356400/
